verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for a SaaS CRM with a public API, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents OAuth scopes, private-app tokens or any per-credential permission limits. The MCP server's "secure read and write access" does not say credentials can be restricted. "Granular reporting permissions" governs who sees reports, not API credentials, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
